editorial.blurb: A beloved Malaysian homecook run by a Rohingya family on Devon Ave, serving authentic dishes at remarkable prices with flavors that keep people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Look for the street numbers rather than a sign—the storefront has no name displayed. Bring cash or Zelle, and ask the staff for recommendations on which nasi goreng variation suits your spice tolerance.

topDishes.note: Complex, fiery heat that impresses even spice-lovers
